env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A block comment that ends the line of one statement does not belong to
# the statement below it. A statement in a group body that needs the
# join check, and a try statement, keep their own line when the line
# above ends in a block comment. The module runs natively, ejects, and
# the ejected module builds and runs with go and with go1.27.2 from
# $UPROOT1272 and prints the same output.
cd m
logos run .
stdout '^1 2$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/commentattach

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"sync/atomic"
)

var total atomic.Int64

func add(n int64) {
	total.Add(n)
}

func fail() error {
	return nil
}

func one() (int, error) {
	return 1, nil
}

func run(ctx context.Context) error {
	go group (ctx) {
		go add(1) /* block comment ending the line of a go statement */
		fail()?
	}
	return nil
}

func sum() (int, error) {
	a := one()? /* block comment ending the line of a try statement */
	b := one()?
	return a + b, nil
}

func main() {
	if err := run(context.Background()); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	n, err := sum()
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(total.Load(), n)
}
